stock_reviews.thesis: The LODHA setup fits a ≤1-month swing due to its strong bullish trend, with an ADX of 46 and RSI of 63, indicating a potential continuation of the uptrend. The stock has outperformed Nifty and its sector in the last month, with returns of 29% and 19.1% respectively. The distance from its 52-week high is only 7.51%, leaving room for further upside. The overall market regime is bullish with low risk, supporting this swing trade.
